items.name: theme
items.title: dylo theme
items.description: Light and dark design tokens plus the Tailwind v4 mapping: the gray and alpha scales, semantic utilities (text-default, bg-interactive, border-interactive, ring-focus, bg-success...), the display, serif and mono families, motion and the marketing effects. Start here in every project.

items.name: catalyst-theme
items.title: dylo theme for Catalyst
items.description: Remaps Tailwind's zinc and blue scales onto the dylo grays so existing Catalyst components follow the theme in light and dark. Import after dylo-theme.css.

items.name: fonts
items.title: dylo webfonts
items.description: Inter, Geist, Playfair Display and Commit Mono over public CDNs, for consumers without a font pipeline. Must be the first line of your stylesheet. Next.js apps should use next/font instead.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Stacked questions that open in place: the pricing FAQ. Each item is its own filled card; the chevron turns a quarter on open.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert dialog
items.description: A confirmation that cannot be dismissed by clicking outside: delete a domain, revoke a key. Say what will happen in the description.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A person (round) or a team (rounded square). The fallback shows initials on a tinted tile.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A status or label chip. The tone carries meaning, so use each one for its status only: success (delivered, verified), warning (delayed, pending), error (bounced, failed), info (opened, clicked), neutral (queued, sent).

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: The trail above a detail page: Domains > example.com.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button group
items.description: Joins adjacent Buttons into one control: shared hairline, squared inner corners. Use for a split action or a small set of related toggles.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: The interface action. `primary` is the solid accent (black in light, white in dark), `secondary` the translucent gray control, `ghost` text only. The default size is the 32px control the dashboard is built from.

items.name: callout
items.title: Callout
items.description: An inline notice: a domain still verifying, a quota nearly reached, an action that cannot be undone. Icon, a sentence, an optional action.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A grouped surface. `outline` is the hairline panel of the dashboard, `subtle` the filled one (FAQ items, stat tiles), `feature` the large marketing panel with a highlight across its top edge.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Lightweight SVG charts for metrics: no chart library, server-rendered. Series colour comes from `currentColor`, so set it with a text utility (text-gray-12 for the main series, text-green-9 for deliverability).

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A 16px square check. Checked and indeterminate fill with the accent.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code block
items.description: Code in the system's mono face: inline Code, a CopyButton, line-numbered CodeLines with grayscale highlighting, and the framed CodeBlock with framework tabs and a copy button.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A searchable single choice for long lists: sending domain, audience, template. Arrow keys move, Enter picks, Escape closes.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context menu
items.description: The right-click menu. Same surface and items as DropdownMenu.

items.name: cta-button
items.title: CTA button
items.description: The marketing call to action. `glass` is a translucent pane with a 2px hairline that fills solid and gains a soft glow on hover; `ghost` is the quiet secondary beside it. Use it on marketing pages and auth screens, not inside the product, where Button is the control.

items.name: date-range-picker
items.title: Date range picker
items.description: The list filter for time: a preset ("Last 15 days") or a custom from / to pair. Dates are ISO strings (yyyy-mm-dd).

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal for a focused task: create an API key, add a domain, add a webhook. Header, body and a footer with the actions right-aligned.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown menu
items.description: The action menu behind every "..." and the team switcher. Items are 32px, 8px-rounded, with an optional 16px icon and a trailing shortcut.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty state
items.description: What a list shows before it has rows: an icon tile, a title, one sentence and the action that fills it. Sits on the faint canvas grid.

items.name: field
items.title: Field and label
items.description: The label above a control: 14px, secondary text, no uppercase.

items.name: icon-button
items.title: Icon button
items.description: A square action that holds one icon: row menus, copy, close, toolbar export. Always give it an `aria-label`.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: The text field. Translucent gray fill and hairline by default; `glass` is the larger frosted field of the auth screens. Pass `leading` or `trailing` for an icon, a prefix or an IconButton inside the field.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A keyboard key: 20px square-ish chip, hidden on touch devices.

items.name: link
items.title: Text link
items.description: An inline text link. `emphasis` is the bold link inside secondary copy ("Don't have an account? Sign up"), `underline` the legal-line link, `muted` the footer and navigation link.

items.name: logo
items.title: Logo
items.description: The monochrome dylo mark or horizontal lockup from public/brand/: black on light, the reversed white file under `.dark`. Never redraw the mark; install brand-assets.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: The footer of a list: "1-40 of 1,204" on the left, previous and next on the right. Pass hrefs for links, or onPrevious / onNext for buttons.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: The floating surface: near-opaque overlay fill, blur, a hairline ring.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A quota bar: emails sent this month, domains used. The fill turns to the warning tone past 80% and the error tone at the limit unless `tone` is set.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio group
items.description: A 16px ring; the checked dot is the accent.

items.name: search
items.title: Search
items.description: The filter-bar search: leading magnifier, optional shortcut hint.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A single-choice dropdown. The trigger matches Input; the menu is the shared popover surface. Filter bars use it for date range, status and API key.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A 1px hairline. Pass children for the centred "or" divider of the auth screens.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A panel that slides in from an edge: an event's detail beside the log, the mobile navigation. Uses the drawer easing.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A loading placeholder in the interactive fill, gently pulsing.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A range input: a 4px rail, a gradient fill and a 20px thumb that grows on hover. Pass `marks` to label the stops underneath, as the pricing slider does.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An on/off toggle. On fills with the accent; the thumb is the opposite tone.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: The list table. The header is a rounded, hairlined band; rows are 56px with a bottom hairline and a hover fill. `density="compact"` gives the 44px rows of comparison tables and DNS records.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Switches between views of one page. `segmented` is the dashboard's Sending / Receiving control, `pill` the larger marketing toggle, `underline` the settings sub-navigation.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line text field with the same fill, hairline and states as Input.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Transient confirmation at the bottom right: "API key copied", "Domain added". Mount <Toaster /> once, then call `toast()` from anywhere.

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: The filter bar above a list: a search that takes the free width, then fixed-width filters and an action at the end. Wraps on narrow screens.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short label on hover or focus. Wrap the app (or the page) in TooltipProvider once.

items.name: dashboard-kit
items.title: Dashboard kit
items.description: The product dashboard: sidebar shell with team switcher and status bar, and every section as a page (emails, templates, audience, inboxes, broadcasts, automations, metrics, domains, logs, API keys, webhooks, settings) with their dialogs, sheets, empty states and the auth screens. Placeholder data lives in data.ts.

items.name: marketing-kit
items.title: Marketing kit
items.description: Marketing site sections: sticky blurred header with menus, serif hero, logo strip, code showcase, feature grids and tab cards, testimonial marquee, closing CTA, footer, pricing (plans, usage slider, comparison tables, add-ons), FAQ, blog, changelog, customer stories, contact form and the docs shell.
